Dosage form(s): This monograph excludes foods or food-like dosage forms as indicated in the Compendium of Monographs Guidance Document.
Acceptable dosage forms for oral use are indicated in the dosage form drop-down list of the web-based Product Licence Application form for Compendial applications.

Use(s) or Purpose(s): Source of an/An essential amino acid for the maintenance of good health (Brayfield and Cadart 2024; IOM 2002).
Source of an/An essential amino acid involved in muscle protein synthesis (Brayfield and Cadart 2024; IOM 2002).
Helps to reduce the recurrence of herpes simplex virus (HSV) infection (e.g., cold sores) (Wright 1994; Griffith et al. 1987;
Simon et al. 1985; McCune et al. 1984; Miller et al. 1984; Thein et al. 1984; Walsh et al. 1983; Griffith et al. 1978).
Helps in collagen formation (Shils et al. 2006; IOM 2002; Groff and Gropper 2000).
Notes
The above uses can be combined on the product label (e.g., Source of an essential amino acid involved in muscle protein synthesis and for the maintenance of good health).
The terms ‘Helps’ or ‘Helps to’ can be used interchangeably on the label.

Quantity(ies): Reduce the recurrence of HSV infection
1,000 - 3,000 milligrams, per day (Wright 1994; Griffith et al. 1987; Simon et al. 1985; McCune et al. 1984; Miller et al. 1984; Thein et al. 1984; Walsh et al. 1983; Griffith et al. 1978).
Other uses
133 - 3,000 milligrams, per day (Wright 1994; Griffith et al. 1987; Simon et al. 1985; McCune et al. 1984; Miller et al. 1984; Thein et al. 1984; Walsh et al. 1983; Griffith et al. 1978).

Caution(s) and warning(s): Products providing more than 300 mg of lysine, per day
Ask a health care practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding (Goldman and Ausiello 2004).
